document.about: The Journal of Headache and Pain (2016) article, PMC4791410, set in two columns. On p3 its Table 1 runs down the left column and Table 2 sits at the foot of the right one, the two tables' last rows side by side, under the right column's prose. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#456): a kicker over the title was a paragraph like any other. It is a `doco:Paragraph` with evidence `kicker`, so a consumer can tell it from the body.
